Allowed origins: `http://localhost:4200` (exact), plus any subdomain of `*.pages.dev` and `*.workers.dev`.

Add a new custom domain in **`worker/src/index.ts`**, inside the `cors({ origin: ... })` callback (around line ~22) — extend the `if` condition, e.g. add `origin.endsWith('.yourdomain.com')` or an exact `origin === 'https://yourdomain.com'`. Since CORS uses a function (not a string array), wildcards must be checked manually here; Hono won't match wildcard array entries. See `docs/DEPLOYMENT_NOTES.md §4 (CORS)` for details.
